documented_probe: C-9316fd7f (call an http endpoint carrying a computed payload): reference floor is easy and this covering task is authored at easy; the verifier re-runs the deliverable script against the live in-container service on hidden dock ids (open, closed, non-integer) and checks the printed final message against the documented formula.
notes: Single flow: start a shipped local kiosk service, discover the claim route and receipt list, compute a sha256-based rendezvous payload for a dock id, POST it, and deliver the returned pier-pass string plus receipt JSON. Hidden cases re-execute the script with unseen open ids (catches hard-coded outputs), a closed id (409 -> non-zero exit, no pierpass on stdout), and a non-integer arg. Easy: no multi-step auth, no auditing, straightforward documented formula.
